note: No latest_dxvk: getLatest asks the three Linux feeds (recorded live once), downloads and extracts all three tools, then installs DXVK into the prefix.
The prefix already holds the tools-dir version: no copy, no wine command, no request.
The tools dir is newer than the prefix: the DLLs are copied, one reg add per DLL name, current_dxvk rewritten. Nothing is downloaded.
A prefix with no syswow64: only the x32 DLLs are copied, into system32, and registered once each.
A winePrefix of ~/prefix is expanded against the user home before any path is used.
A GPU that only supports Vulkan 1.2: getLatest asks the pinned DXVK v1.10.3 and VKD3D v2.6 tags, and dxvk-nvapi latest.
No Vulkan device at all: the warning is logged and the latest feeds are asked anyway.
The DXVK archive answers 500: showDialog ERROR is sent, nothing is extracted, and installRemove then rejects reading the missing latest_dxvk.
Offline with no tools dir: getLatest is skipped (warning), no request is made, and installRemove rejects reading the missing latest_dxvk.
No .update-timestamp: warning, returns true, nothing touched (the toggle must not stay stuck).
A wine binary whose path contains "toolkit" (Game Porting Toolkit): returns true before looking at the prefix.
Toggle remove: current_dxvk removed, one reg delete per DLL name, the tool DLLs deleted, then wineboot -u. TS keeps no backup of the stock DLLs: wineboot -u is what restores them.
Remove on a prefix that holds neither the DLLs nor current_dxvk: the same reg delete and wineboot calls run, the missing DLLs are logged as errors.
dxvk-nvapi install: copy, reg add per name, then nvngx.dll and _nvngx.dll are copied from the vulkan-helper nvapi-path and NGXCore FullPath is written.
dxvk-nvapi install where the helper finds no nvngx path: warning, no NGXCore reg add.
dxvk-nvapi remove: reg delete nvapi and nvapi64, both DLLs deleted, wineboot -u.
vkd3d install: the 32-bit DLLs come from x86 (not x32), the 64-bit ones from x64.
vkd3d remove.
A GameLib-pinned DXVK (Steam fallback engine): copy is synchronous, system.reg is the prefix check, the tools dir is never read, the version file is written before it resolves.
CR-03: a source-pinned install recopies even when the version file already matches.

Strict restore: DLLs removed first, ONE reg import (CRLF reg file under drive_c), one reg query per override judged by exit code, wineboot -u because the stock DLLs are missing, version file removed last. Every step wait:false, resolveOnExit.
The first wine process (the import) runs the prefix update that puts the stock DLLs back: wineboot -u is skipped.
reg import exits 1: no /v query runs (code 1 is trusted only after a good import), returns false, the version file is kept.
reg query d3d11 exits 0 (the override is still there): returns false, the version file is kept.
wineboot -u exits 3: returns false, the version file is kept.
On macOS the tool becomes dxvk-macOS and getLatest asks only the pinned Gcenx v1.10.3-20230507-repack tag (recorded live once); current_dxvk-macOS is written into the CrossOver bottle.
The feed lists a -builtin asset first: it is skipped for the repack.tar.gz asset.
The bottle already holds the tools-dir dxvk-macOS version: nothing runs.
The dxvk-macOS archive answers 500: showDialog ERROR, then installRemove rejects reading the missing latest_dxvk-macOS.
Offline on macOS with no tools dir: no request, installRemove rejects.
Tools dir present, bottle without current_dxvk-macOS: copy, reg add, current_dxvk-macOS written.
Toggle remove on the CrossOver bottle (current_dxvk-macOS removed).
Only DXVK exists on macOS: any other tool returns true without touching the bottle.
Only DXVK exists on macOS: vkd3d restore returns true without touching the bottle.
A wine whose name ends in -DXMT never gets DXVK.
The Game Porting Toolkit wine never gets DXVK.
A pinned-engine (Wine Staging) bottle: the pinned source is copied synchronously and current_dxvk-macOS records its version.
Strict restore on a pinned-engine bottle (engine switch back to CrossOver): reg import, queries, wineboot -u, current_dxvk-macOS removed last.
